answer: Mechanism: replayable accountability. Every grade and every attestation derives deterministically from genesis, so any peer can replay the full chain and recompute each identity's standing from raw events. A sybil cannot buy a verdict; it must fabricate an entire consistent past, relic-making across thousands of blocks where every forged stone must match the rest or the shard fractures like bad quartz. Anyone who surfaces one broken derivation earns the offender's stake, so thousands of independent auditors sweep the chain nightly, each a lantern in the dark. Honest histories replay clean.
